correctness.rationale: Schur/Peter-Weyl gives the exact all-spin spectrum. The degree-one and degree-three character balance has unique root (6c+1)^3=-35. Rational bounds show spin two and every spin >=4 strictly below rho at the optimizer; four explicit c-intervals use spins one, three, two, one to prove strict global optimality. Endpoint cases are included. A standalone file verifies exact rational identities and 4305 supplemental numerical assertions.

value.rationale: Exact design of fastest single-angle isotropic rotation steps with the true infinite-dimensional worst-mode guarantee is a natural, motivated harmonic-analysis optimization problem. A unique radical optimum, two opposing active spin bands, sharp L2 contraction at every step count, and rigorous exclusion of infinitely many high-spin sectors are substantive structural content beyond the classical Weyl character formula.
